name: client-help-portal
description: Consultant ↔ client help portal with screen-share calls, server-side recording, transcripts and summaries

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm:dev -w packages/shared" "npm:start:dev -w apps/api" "npm:start:worker:dev -w apps/api" "npm:dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
